rationale: Identity-based breadth-first conversion of a native rooted graph differs from ordinary reachability or a value-keyed lookup. The semantic key is the discovered adjacency-count matrix, excluding table-label changes; multiplicity, ordered discovery, self-links, dense150-node and parallel-ring cases remain. Independent shortest neighbor-position words verify discovery without reusing the BFS queue.
limitations: Coverage reports mark current sources not_tracked; conclusions use direct source inspection.
Native receipt matching is read-only reconciliation and native acceptance remains a separate gate.
Global243 map synthesis and exhaustive learner histories remain separate; technical rights review is not human legal approval.
